CLOUD REVIEWER seat for PR #2605 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head 7651b942166e994a29d4b2178ba551ac43565b73. Bus nonce: 8e37448d9ee66b51b88aa5a9afe4b92e. Never send push notifications.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md and its rules from main, and follow them exactly. Fetch the PR head with `git fetch origin 7651b942166e994a29d4b2178ba551ac43565b73`; the PR body is in the PR. Verify each claim adversarially: mutate the fix and check the tests fail, and check every figure in the body at this head. Check that it merges with origin/main (`git merge-tree --write-tree`) and read CI on this head from the check-runs API.
Output: in a fresh directory of your own (`W=$(mktemp -d)`), write verdict.md, whose first line is exactly `Fix review: merge 7651b942166e994a29d4b2178ba551ac43565b73` or `Fix review: blocked 7651b942166e994a29d4b2178ba551ac43565b73 <class>: <reason>` (no brackets; the class is lower-case letters and dashes), in the format the role file gives, then a blank line, then `bus-nonce: 8e37448d9ee66b51b88aa5a9afe4b92e`, then the body in sections. A blocked verdict's block goes under `## Block`. Each finding this PR does not settle (a defect, a surviving mutant, a deferral, a follow-up, a task owed after the merge) is its own bullet under `## Findings` ending in its own `Carry: <GROUP> | #<issue> | O<n> | dismissed: <reason>` (finding-propagation.md). Everything else (RESULT lines, re-runs, CI state, figures you could not re-derive) goes under `## Evidence`: tools/audit/carry_audit.py reads no item there as a finding unless it hands something on (deferred, for a later, follow-up, minor, advisory, residual, still has to, not blocking ...; a check that does not block is evidence only in the clause saying it is not a required check and does not block, never in the rest of its sentence: a nit or defect beside it is a finding), and the merge train parks a verdict holding a finding with no `Carry:`. Put the evidence files in `ev/` beside it, and make at least one file under `ev/` contain the full 40-hex head `7651b942166e994a29d4b2178ba551ac43565b73` (e.g. `ev/HEAD.txt` holding the head you reviewed, beside your command output): bus.sh refuses a verdict whose `ev/` names no head. Do NOT run bus.sh: its dispatch record lives on the orchestrator's machine, which publishes the verdict there (cloud_relay.sh). Return the verdict on a probe ref, and push nothing else; this builds one parentless commit with a private index and touches no branch of your checkout: `R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); G=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir); mkdir -p $W/pr && cp -r $W/verdict.md $W/ev $W/pr/ && cd $W/pr && T=$(GIT_DIR=$G GIT_INDEX_FILE=$W/idx GIT_WORK_TREE=$W/pr sh -c 'git add -A -f . && git write-tree') && C=$(GIT_DIR=$G git -c user.name=seat -c user.email=seat@users.noreply.github.com commit-tree $T -m "verdict 2605 7651b942166e994a29d4b2178ba551ac43565b73") && git -C $R push -q origin $C:refs/heads/probe/rev-2605-8e37448d`. That ref is the return signal. Do not post comments, approve or merge.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
First review of PR #2605 (group R10-NIGHTLY-PYSPY-RETRY, branch fix/r10-nightly-pyspy-retry) at head 7651b942166e994a29d4b2178ba551ac43565b73. It builds countermeasure A of dev/audit/rca/nightly-ha-pyspy-timeout.md (#2479) in tests/nightly_ha.py:
- py-spy is cut at PY_SPY_TIMEOUT_S = 5 s;
- hb:positive_control retries over fresh spins (HB_CONTROL_TRIES = 3);
- worst-case waits are bounded under HB_HANG_S.
The body DISCLOSES that this does not remove the nightly red: real HA hung on 3 of 3 attempts in one held spin, and the hang is per process, not per sample. Follow dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md, using the finder's harness the group brief names (roster: dev/programme/rosters/wave-r10-groups.json, group R10-NIGHTLY-PYSPY-RETRY). PREPR_SKIP_CLOSURES=1.
Required:
- Judge soundness: is merging an improvement that cannot clear the red sound, or does it mask the red? The check's power must be kept. A stub that never answers, or answers without naming the spin, must still fail hb:positive_control. Verify with the null controls.
- The residual, a per-process hang, must have an owner. If the body only discloses it, that is a finding with a Carry to a live group (or a new-group proposal); never leave it undisposed.
- Re-run the failing-test-first evidence and the mutation proof: one attempt only, timeout removed, and any non-empty output accepted must each go red. Re-derive every figure: F5-F9, the 710/710 samples, and the 22 s and 3 × 5 s bounds. Each quantified claim needs a null control.
- carry_audit.py check over the body gives 0 unrouted. git merge-tree --write-tree origin/main 7651b942166e994a29d4b2178ba551ac43565b73 must be clean.
- Read check-runs at this head. A red whose log shows "API rate limit exceeded" is external; the installation limit was hit at 09:44Z. nightly-status and delivery-status are not required.
- ev/HEAD.txt holds the full head, and VERDICT carries bus-nonce: 8e37448d9ee66b51b88aa5a9afe4b92e. No /Users/ or /private/ path may appear in VERDICT.md or ev/.
